purpose: Derived, non-authoritative coverage audit linked by IDs to existing canonical 13 YKI patterns, NOT a duplicate task taxonomy or a claim of exact 2027 coverage.

Listening choice, true/false and open response; historical repeats/paper instructions are NOT digital.

Sustained talk, dialogue, situational reactions, opinion in examples; historical timings not 2027 rules.
Communicative reception, production, interaction can-do descriptors; not YKI item counts.
Construct validity, representative sampling, avoiding construct-irrelevant variance, human rating.

intended_planning_coverage.sampling_method: For each candidate complete form, select disjoint unseen item sources across all four skills, at least two text/audio genres across receptive blocks where corpus allows, more than one communication function per module, varied speakers, and meaningful B1/B2 language demand; subject to independent S2 test specification review and future first-party digital corroboration.
intended_planning_coverage.closed_form_policy: Do not score or expose a full-exam claim until all mandatory S2/license/format/reliability gates are satisfied.

quality_gates.criterion: 13/13 canonical families mapped exactly once with honest historical-vs-live provenance
Per-genre/functions and B1/B2 demand annotated on each original task with source/rights
Two independent Finnish S2 reviewers on released original task prompts, keys, alternatives; conflicts adjudicated
Listening open/T-F and speaking multi-turn + narrative implemented after S2/audio licensing
Distractors require understanding intent/gist/detail/inference not keyword spotting; review alternative correct interpretations
Held-out independent forms remain unseen; post-exam LEARN cannot contaminate later EXAM scores
No official digital length/count, timer or form-quota asserted until OPH first-party evidence and E2E
User outcomes for E03 item diversity validated in distinct pilot, discrimination and fairness checked with adequate samples

non_accomplishments: No manual Inspera digital UI observation
No original Finnish task added or S2-approved
No complete calibrated test form published
rights_policy: Original independently authorized content only; official questions, audio and answer keys remain links/descriptive sources unless explicitly licensed.
